story.headline: From Kitchen Hobby to Saturday Tradition
paragraphs: Knead & Bake TX started in 2024 with a single jar of sourdough starter and a lot of curiosity. What began as a weekend experiment — mixing flour and water, watching bubbles form, learning to read the dough — quickly became an obsession.

After months of practice, dozens of failed loaves (and a few spectacular ones), we started sharing bread with neighbors and friends. Their reactions told us everything: "This is the best bread I've ever had." "Can I buy a loaf next week?" "You should sell this at the market."

So in early 2025, we set up a booth at the Castell Street Market in New Braunfels. Every Saturday, we bring fresh-baked sourdough — hand-shaped, slow-fermented, made with as few ingredients as possible.

We're not a factory. We don't cut corners. Every loaf gets 2–3 days of slow fermentation because that's what makes sourdough taste the way it should. No commercial yeast, no preservatives, no shortcuts.

values.title: Simple Ingredients
values.description: Flour, water, salt, and time. That's the foundation of every loaf. We source unbleached, high-quality flour and let nature do the rest.

values.title: Slow Fermentation
values.description: Every loaf gets a 24-48 hour cold ferment. This develops complex flavor, better texture, and makes the bread easier to digest.

values.title: Handmade, Always
values.description: No machines shape our dough. Every loaf is hand-mixed, hand-folded, and hand-shaped. You can taste the difference.

values.title: Community First
values.description: We bake for our neighbors. The farmers market isn't just where we sell — it's where we connect with the people who make New Braunfels special.

values.title: Local When Possible
values.description: We work with Texas-based mills and source seasonal ingredients from nearby farms and producers.

values.title: Share the Knowledge
values.description: We believe everyone can bake great bread. That's why we share recipes, tips, and our starter kit — for free.

allergenStatement: All of our products are made in a home kitchen that handles wheat, nuts, dairy, sesame, and eggs. While we take care to prevent cross-contamination, we cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment. Please review individual item allergens before ordering. If you have a severe allergy, reach out to us directly so we can discuss your needs.

findUs.title: Find Us at the Market
findUs.description: We're at the Castell Street Market in New Braunfels every Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. Look for the Knead & Bake TX banner — we're usually near the east entrance.
